piezas.titulo: Reading comprehension: Transport and getting around
texto: Contextual reading of an exchange at a transport information desk: read the dialogue in which a passenger finds out how to get to the centre and whether she needs to change lines. Notice the clarity of the instructions and the names of the stations.

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «การปฏิบัติตามกฎจราจรและป้ายเตือนช่วยเพิ่มความปลอดภัยแก่ผู้ใช้ถนนทุกคน» express?

opciones.texto: Obeying traffic rules and road signs ensures shared road safety.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «การปฏิบัติตามกฎจราจรและป้ายเตือนช่วยเพิ่มความปลอดภัยแก่ผู้ใช้ถนนทุกคน» from the text.

opciones.texto: Integrated transport passes give flexibility when getting around.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Planning alternative routes lets you avoid traffic jams at rush hour.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: According to the station information, what must the passenger do before reaching her destination?

opciones.texto: Take the bus and change to the train at that point
opciones.explicacion: Correct: the officer explains «นั่งรถเมล์สายนี้ไป แล้วต้องเปลี่ยนรถที่นี่ครับ».
